libraryStrings.sqlResultSuccessDescription: Result: {rows} rows, {columns} columns. Check whether this is what the task asks for.
libraryStrings.sqlResultNoRowsTitle: Query executed, but no row matches.
libraryStrings.sqlResultNoRowsDescription: The result has 0 rows ({columns} columns). Try adjusting your condition.
libraryStrings.sqlResultEmptyDescription: The query ran, but it did not return a table yet.
libraryStrings.sqlErrorSyntaxKeyword: Syntax error near "{token}". Did you mean the keyword {suggestion}?
libraryStrings.sqlErrorSyntax: Syntax error near "{token}". Check commas, parentheses, quotes and the order of the clauses (SELECT … FROM … WHERE … ORDER BY).
libraryStrings.sqlErrorIncomplete: The statement is incomplete. A closing parenthesis, a quote or a part of the query is probably missing.
libraryStrings.sqlErrorNoColumn: The column "{name}" does not exist. Check the spelling in the table overview.
libraryStrings.sqlErrorNoColumnSuggestion: The column "{name}" does not exist. Did you mean "{suggestion}"?
libraryStrings.sqlErrorNoTable: The table "{name}" does not exist. Check the spelling in the table overview.
libraryStrings.sqlErrorNoTableSuggestion: The table "{name}" does not exist. Did you mean "{suggestion}"?
libraryStrings.sqlErrorAmbiguous: The column "{name}" exists in several tables. Write it as table.column.
libraryStrings.sqlErrorAggregate: An aggregate function (COUNT, SUM, AVG, …) is used in the wrong place. In WHERE use a normal condition; for aggregates use HAVING.
libraryStrings.sqlErrorToken: Unrecognized character or text "{token}". Text values need single quotes, e.g. 'Europe'.
libraryStrings.sqlErrorFunction: The function "{name}" does not exist in SQLite. Check the spelling.
libraryStrings.sqlHintUnknownTableSuggestion: Table "{name}" was not found. Did you mean "{suggestion}"?
libraryStrings.sqlHintUnknownColumnSuggestion: Column "{name}" was not found. Did you mean "{suggestion}"?
libraryStrings.sqlFeedbackSuccess: Your query returns the correct columns and rows.
libraryStrings.sqlFeedbackFailure: Your query is not correct yet. Check {rows} row differences and {cols} column differences.
libraryStrings.sqlFeedbackConstraint: The result is not enough yet. Requirements not met: {violations}.
libraryStrings.sqlFeedbackRows: Your query is not correct yet: {missing} rows are missing, {extra} rows are too many.
libraryStrings.sqlFeedbackColumns: The columns do not match yet. Fix the SELECT list first. {details}
libraryStrings.sqlFeedbackRowOrder: The rows are correct, but in a different order. Check the sorting (ORDER BY).
libraryStrings.sqlFeedbackFailureVariant: Your query does not return the right result for the test data "{name}".
libraryStrings.sqlFeedbackFailureHidden: Your query returns a wrong result for a hidden test. Check whether it also works with other data.
libraryStrings.sqlSetupSqlFailed: The setup SQL of a test case failed: {message}
